cases.scenario: A checked body would require a wrong operand type/stack shape.
A bounds-invalid container access uses the selected checked/trapping contract and cannot corrupt memory.
An integer/bytes value is presented as a live resource handle without a validated host-issued capability.
A live resource or resource-bearing aggregate is passed to generic dup/drop/quote/serialization.
A program with empty effect bound attempts a guest host operation.
A program whose effect set names fs.read runs without an authorized Directory/resource.
A valid Wasm module arrives with forged Noble recipe/type metadata and no trusted correspondence path.
A host callback returns a stale/wrong-kind/cross-context resource representation.
Malformed or over-limit Preserves input is received at a standard-concurrency boundary.
A valid Preserves value fails the declared protocol schema and must not enter typed Noble code.
Two standard-profile actors attempt direct shared mutable Noble memory rather than dataspace/resource interaction.
A facet/actor terminates and its scope-owned assertions/interests/subordinate conversational activity are retired/retracted.
Execution budget or memory quota is exhausted; result is a specified profile failure, not language-level undefined behavior.
Guest source attempts an unsafe/transmute/raw-pointer escape from the checked semantics.
A future dependent/higher-rank/subtyping feature may only join the stable-safe subset after affected checker/proof obligations are complete.
